# EchoLink packet fixture provenance

Reference: SvxLink/EchoLib 26.05.2, commit
`595cf9bb3325be753d05b219bdd39feab6a22b33`.

Control literals are independently hand-derived from the pinned
[`rtpacket.cpp`](https://github.com/sm0svx/svxlink/blob/595cf9bb3325be753d05b219bdd39feab6a22b33/src/echolib/rtpacket.cpp#L15-L138)
maker, not generated by our packet library or adapter. The input callsign is
`N0CALL`; NAME combines its 15-character left-justified field and the specified
station name. CNAME/EMAIL are `CALLSIGN`, PHONE is `08:30`, and optional PRIV is
the five raw bytes `SPEEX`. END plus the maker's extra zero and alignment explain
the surplus word in two cases. These literals have not yet been validated by
executing the original maker; do not describe them as a captured client trace.

Voice headers follow the packed structure and send operation in
[`EchoLinkQso.h`](https://github.com/sm0svx/svxlink/blob/595cf9bb3325be753d05b219bdd39feab6a22b33/src/echolib/EchoLinkQso.h#L149-L159)
and
[`EchoLinkQso.cpp`](https://github.com/sm0svx/svxlink/blob/595cf9bb3325be753d05b219bdd39feab6a22b33/src/echolib/EchoLinkQso.cpp#L975-L1028).
Version is 3; GSM uses four 33-byte units and an 80 ms span. The opaque payloads
test header preservation only: they are **not codec-verified speech or silence**.
Speex's raw second byte is `0x96`, i.e. standard RTP marker=true/payload type=22.

Upstream attribution: EchoLib/SvxLink by Tobias Blomberg/SM0SVX and contributors,
GPL-2.0-or-later under the pinned project's COPYRIGHT. No app_rpt implementation
code is incorporated. Reference fixture bytes document interoperability; the
EchoLink compatibility wrapper is independently implemented.
